summary: Delegate coding, repository analysis, file edits, test runs, or code review to the local Codex CLI without embedding an OpenAI API key. This skill was created to work with ChatGPT/Codex enterprise accounts that may not have the same level of API access. Invokes codex exec with existing ChatGPT/Codex CLI authentication and returns Codex's final output.
